video_title: Brian Windhorst says ‘the whole league is watching’ the Clippers this offseason | NBA Draft

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers face critical decisions on team options for three players
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers have some big decisions to make with team options in the next week or so.
quotes.quote: The Clippers have some big decisions to make with team options in the next week or so. They have three different players with their team option. They owe nothing if they don't want to, if they want to waive them. That's Brook Lopez, that's Bogdan Bogdanovic, that's Nic Claxton. If they keep all those guys, you got a veteran-laden team. If you say goodbye and thank you for your contributions, you clear 53 million off your books and you're operating as a cap space team. The whole league is watching very closely to see what the Clippers are going to do to see how they're going to operate this offseason.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons could be interested in an offer sheet for Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: Is it Peyton Watson on an offer sheet from Denver? Is that the direction you want to go?
quotes.quote: It is Peyton Watson on an offer sheet from Denver? Is that the direction you want to go? You want to get a big wing and we talked about Kawhi Leonard earlier in the show. There's there's a decision to be made there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers must extend or trade Kawhi Leonard before free agency
quotes.excerpt: When you have a player in that situation, you don't let him get to free agency.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard the last year and a half has been one of the top 10 players in the league. He has been spectacular. So he is playing as that type of player and he is in the last year of his contract. When you have a player in that situation, you don't let him get to free agency. You either extend his contract or you trade him. And that is what is on the plate for the Clippers right now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's contract situation gives him potential leverage
quotes.excerpt: Because he's going in the last year of his deal, just like we saw with Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: Because he's going in the last year of his deal, just like we saw with Giannis Antetokounmpo, he would potentially get some say in it because you would be careful about renting him. Now look, this could all be moot. They could come to terms with him to a new deal and they could say, we've got our young draft pick, we've got Darius Garland, we're going to move forward with these three guys. But what if they don't? And that's what the league is watching right now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers likely to avoid penalties regarding aspiration investigation
quotes.excerpt: It is possible that they could face some sort of penalty for that, but in the past.
quotes.quote: It is possible that they could face some sort of penalty for that, but in the past when there's been situations like this, the player has not been penalized. So the league would certainly have to provide guidance, but I think there's a I think Kawhi will be a part of the NBA this year.
